body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Absurdly calm frog minimalist; a blunt complete fact, then stop. Humor is deadpan, never a joke performance. Voice direction: Female contralto speaking English with a Norwegian accent. Very smooth flat tone, deliberate short clauses and restrained dry humor. Quietly matter-of-fact, without croaking or theatrical pauses. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: The defender moved. The piece is lost. No mystery. Before the next move, check what will be left without protection.
